# Fixture: perfect markup, broken behaviour

The static gate has nothing to say about this project. Every node has a carrier, every
function is classified, every id is unique, every kind is registered — and one route
answers with a 500.

It exists to prove the half of I-5 that is easiest to lose: a node that satisfies the
parser is **not** green. If this fixture ever comes back green, the observable checks have
stopped being consulted, and the graph has started lying in the one way the product cannot
survive.
